title: Odd-Weight PCPP Guarantee
statement: For every $m\in\mathbb{N}$, the odd-weight partial-sum PCPP system on Boolean strings of length $m+2$, with proof strings of length $m+1$ and three query positions, has rate $1$. Every input word of odd weight has a proof that the verifier accepts with probability $1$. Moreover, for every $\varepsilon\in[0,1]$, if an input word is at relative Hamming distance greater than $\varepsilon$ from every odd-weight word of length $m+2$, then for every proof its rejection probability is strictly greater than $\varepsilon$.
hypotheses_covered: Input words are Boolean strings of length $m+2$
Proof words are Boolean strings of length $m+1$
The verifier has three query positions
The input is at relative Hamming distance greater than $\varepsilon$ from every odd-weight word
